item.title: A Decade of Slug
item.description:
📝 This post talks about what has changed within the rendering method since 2017, when the paper was published and the Slug Library was first released. Though not necessary for rendering text at ordinary sizes, adaptive supersampling was implemented in early versions of Slug to enhance text drawn at very small sizes. Removing supersampling also simplified the pixel shader considerably.
🔗 Read more: https://terathon.com/blog/decade-slug.html

item.title: Show HN: Horizon – GPU-accelerated infinite-canvas terminal in Rust
item.description:
